name: Bailan Daxuesheng Hui Yudao Feiwu Shen
original_name: 摆烂大学生会遇到废物神
source:
Wang Liuma (name changeable) is an ordinary fourth-year university student juggling her internship, dreaming of a glamorous life full of success and recognition.

One evening after work, she meets someone who claims to be a god — and from that day on, her life continues to be just as boring as ever.

“But wait — this script has to be wrong somewhere, right?!”

Enjoy the romantic comedy of a slacker college girl who just can't catch a break —

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5040230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
王琉玛（姓名可更改）是一名一边忙着实习、一边幻想着功成名就光鲜人生的普通大四女学生。

某天傍晚下班后，她偶遇了一个自称是神明的家伙——而从那天起，她的生活也依然像从前一样无聊透顶。

“等一下——这剧本绝对哪里搞错了吧？！”

敬请享受这部倒霉摆烂女大学生的轻松恋爱喜剧——

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5040230/]Steam[/url]]
